@@ -5,3 +5,18 @@ A tiny greeting library.
 ## Install
 
     npm install greet
+
+## Usage
+
+```js
+const { greet } = require("greet");
+
+greet("Ada");   // "Hello, Ada!"
+greet("");      // "Hello, friend!"
+```
+
+An empty or blank name greets the default, `friend`.
+
+## Shouting
+
+`shout(name)` is `greet(name)` in capitals.
